Description.SourceString:
Those four fools thought they had stolen an ordinary carpet. Ha! Not once did they realise I could hear every word. I let them carry me from that dreadful vault, lay me beside their campfire and fall fast asleep. Then I slipped away with their chest and left them to blame one another. Such accusations! Such language!

Three of them chased me halfway across the desert before greed did the rest. I buried the chest while they scattered after me, somewhere none of them would think to look twice. A fine spot for my fortune, high on a mesa where I could watch those fools scour the desert below. The broken ridge lay beneath me, the sinking sands beyond it, with Kalphites crawling amongst the gypsum.

Let them chase shadows while I enjoy the sun for once. Just five minutes in this warmth. After decades beneath that pyramid, I think I’ve earned it. Then I’ll collect my fortune and be on my way.
Assuming I can get these tassels moving again...
